Ivy (PM): Quick sync — Acme pilot asked for model-level caching + HSM integration. Need to lock sequencing across runtime/infra/security. Customer expects pilot by EOW month. Who owns deploy order and scope?

Samir (Eng): We need runtime changes: KV cache eviction policy + variant routing to quantized model. Rough ETA: 3w dev + 1w validation. Infra capacity and KMS choice are blockers.

Jonah (Runtime): Agreed. Also need pinned model variants and a canary path. Prefetch/batching tweak could spike latency during rollout; propose feature-flagged changes only.

Priya (Infra): Heads up — pure KMS (hosted) is fast; HSM procurement for a customer-managed HSM adds ~4w (procurement + ops). Network/VPC review adds days for onprem. Need customer to confirm requirement.

Eli (Security): I'll triage. Need a threat model + clear dataflow for keys. If keys leave customer boundary that's a no-go. HSM alternatives: customer-managed CMK in AWS KMS with External Key Access — requires design doc.

Ivy (PM): Ok let's sequence: 1) runtime change (Samir/Jonah), 2) infra KMS decision (Priya), 3) security signoff (Eli). If HSM is optional we can aim for soft-launch in ~5w, if HSM required timeline ~9w. Is that realistic?

Samir (Eng): 5w is tight but doable if we freeze scope: only add routing + eviction, no batching changes. Need dedicated 2-sprint slots and test harness for regression. I'll block time.

Jonah (Runtime): I'll prototype canary flow this week. Suggest canary=10% -> fallback to standard model on errors. Need SRE support for rollout automation and KV cache warmup plan.

Nina (SRE): We can run the canary. Need updated runbook + alert thresholds (latency > 200ms P95, error rate > 1%). Will assign oncall to monitor first 24h.

Priya (Infra): Decision item for procurement: Hans needs PO + contract if customer insists on HSM. Without HSM, we can use our hosted KMS within current SLA. Can Ivy confirm with Acme?

Ivy (PM): @Acme contact said HSM is "preferred" but not mandatory. I'll confirm and push for hosted KMS to hit pilot date. Will update here in 24h.

Eli (Security): Starting the security checklist now. Please attach design doc and sample (anonymized) dataset for regression test. Also list any user-visible header changes.

Samir (Eng): Adding a CI job idea: `/deploy canary --percent 10 --model X` — we'll add smoke tests that hit both routes and assert fallbacks. Need infra flag to switch routing.

Jonah (Runtime): Created backlog task ROUTE-642: "variant routing + canary support". Target PR by Fri.

Ivy (PM): Action items recap: Ivy confirm HSM preference (24h); Samir/Jonah produce dev plan and PR timeline; Priya verify procurement lead times + fallback option; Eli prepare security checklist; Nina draft runbook and alerting. Sync Friday 10:00am. :thumbsup:
